neighbours.label: Crediting a named party in thanks: the 'for' (or the possessive after it) that follows 'thanks to / grateful to / indebted to X'
fire: The authors are grateful to the harbour board for the access it gave them to its archives.
Our warmest thanks go to Mrs. Okafor for her patience with a room full of beginners.
I owe a great debt to my supervisor for the hours he spent on the first draft.
The society wishes to thank the mayor's office for its generous grant toward the new roof.
We are deeply indebted to the night nurses for the kindness they showed our father.
Special thanks are due to Tom Reyes for his drawings of the excavated pottery.
The family would like to thank the lifeboat crew for their courage on the night of the storm.
She said she was grateful to her old teacher for the faith he had shown in her.
quiet: The authors wrote to the harbour board about the access rules for its archives.
Our longest lesson was with Mrs. Okafor in a room full of beginners.
I sent a long email to my supervisor about the hours wasted on the first draft.
The society asked the mayor's office about a generous grant toward the new roof.
We were deeply worried about the night nurses and the hours they were working.
The drawings of the excavated pottery were made by Tom Reyes in a single week.
The family watched the lifeboat crew launch on the night of the storm.
She said she had argued with her old teacher over the marks he had given her.

notes: Card flags broad (1.1% of tokens reach 0.1 of max). Top examples: thank-you sentences peaking on 'for', 'the', 'his' after the thanked party, and contact clauses with a first-person subject ('a letter I received', 'advisors we can count on'). The + pole is about multiple authorship (written by, multiple writers). Probes: 'grateful to the council for' 0.51, 'thanks to Dr. Lee for her' 0.47, 'thank the mayor for his' 0.45, 'indebted to my editor for' 0.43, 'thank the volunteers for' 0.18, 'Thank you very much for the' 0.26; contact clauses 'a letter I received' 0.58, 'a team we trust with' 0.61. Controls were not quiet: 'a letter that arrived' 0.29, 'voted for the new budget' 0.20, 'left the volunteers for a better job' 0.17. The label covers the thanks half only.
